title: Indian-Style Tender Rigatoni Pasta
description: A fusion of Indian spices and tender pasta. Perfect as a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of Croatian olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté the diced onion until translucent. Set aside.
In the same skillet, add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dried basil, ground cumin, and ground coriander to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and coconut milk to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked rigatoni pasta to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
